title: Strict chain data for the completed scalar comparison
statement:
theorem completed_formula_chain_data :
    ∃ b : inverseImageIntegralModules l E g ⋙ completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι X ≅
        completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι Y ⋙ inverseImageIntegralModules l L g,
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (U : X.ProEt)
        (p : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
        (a : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L Y).obj.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        (b.hom.app M).val.app (op U)
          (completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι X
            ((inverseImageIntegralModules l E g).obj M) (op U)
            ((inverseImageCompletedCoefficientMap l L g).hom.app (op U) a) p) =
          completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι Y M
            (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) a p [def-weil-isomorphism-scalar-completed-model-vocabulary, def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, def-weil-proetale-iso-sectionwise-inverse-image, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]

proof.text: Compare the completed coefficient square after every finite quotient projection. The prescribed residues of completedCoefficientMap, the limit-lift equations of inverseImageCompletedCoefficientMap, and naturality of the constant-section comparison identify the composites. Joint monicity gives the square.

The coefficient square identifies restriction of scalars followed by sectionwise inverse image with sectionwise inverse image followed by restriction. Construct its natural isomorphism as the identity on sections, checking linearity with the inverse coefficient square.

Use the ordinary scalar adjunction with its normalized unit and the equivalence of sectionwise inverse image. Apply the generic adjunction-square isomorphism from the limit scalar comparison construction. Its unit equation gives the pure-tensor rule for scalar 1.

Write a pure tensor as a scalar times its unit tensor. Linearity of the comparison and cancellation of the completed coefficient isomorphism give the formula for an arbitrary scalar. The argument uses the sheafified tensor and does not identify tensor sheaf sections with a sectionwise tensor product.

statement_change.what: The old top-level statement equated chain maps with different endpoints, and its Lean attachment replaced that ill-typed equality with HEq. Inverse-image complexes are not the strict quotient Roos complexes: their specified augmentation has zero shifted coordinate and is only a quasi-isomorphism on complete inputs. The good subcategory imposes K-flatness and flat terms, not derived completeness. Strict cone naturality cannot supply the asserted identification. Replace this false model identification by the actual underived sheaf tensor isomorphism of Tag 03EL and apply it degreewise in the sole consumer, whose statement is unchanged.
